Abstract: Metabolic and bariatric surgery (MBS) effectively treats obesity in reproductive-age women and has been linked to improvements in pre-existing mental health conditions. This systematic review of seven studies, encompassing 4992 participants, revealed higher rates of antenatal depression (7.6%-38%) and anxiety (24.4%-64%) in post-MBS women.
